Description.description: One row from an uploaded extract that failed validation during intake (BR-002, FR-002, FR-003). It captures the source row, the case reference where present, the failure reason and a resolution status so the intake team can triage and re-submit. Belongs to one Import Batch.
The Intelligent Office reference from the row where present (BR-001). May be blank when the row is missing its key.
Triage state of the import exception: Open, Resolved or Ignored.
Triage state of the exception: Open when raised, Resolved once corrected and re-submitted, or Ignored if intentionally skipped (FR-003).
Each exception belongs to one import batch. Restrict delete keeps the exception history under the batch (FR-002).
Stable business code for the exception. Alternate key, so re-processing the same failed row upserts rather than duplicating under NFR-REL-01 (AD-014).
Unique identifier for the import exception.
Short label identifying the import exception in lists.
The raw row payload captured for triage. Holds no more personal data than the source extract.
Why the row failed validation, shown to the intake team so they can correct and re-submit (BR-002).

What was done about the row when the exception was closed - corrected and re-imported, or set aside as never a case (BR-002, FR-002/FR-003). Written only by al_ResolveImportException, and kept separate from al_reason so closing an exception never overwrites why it failed.
When the exception was resolved or dismissed (FR-003). Empty until then.
The row's position in the source extract, for locating it in the file (FR-002).
Unique identifier of the user who created the record.
Date and time when the record was created.
Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.
Sequence number of the import that created this record.
Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.
Date and time when the record was modified.
Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.
Date and time that the record was migrated.
Owner Id
Unique identifier for the business unit that owns the record
Unique identifier for the team that owns the record.
Unique identifier for the user that owns the record.
